objective: Compare four record-sharing conditions with a fixed optimizer. Apply the literature-rule multiplier to the Nernst–Einstein conductivity estimate.

config.purpose: Compare four record-sharing conditions with a fixed optimizer. Apply the literature-rule multiplier to the Nernst–Einstein conductivity estimate.
config.name: sharing_conditions

data.database: OEDB, Open Electrolyte Database for Batteries
data.mcp_server_name: MCP for Open Electrolyte Database for Batteries (OEDB)

concentration_scaling.method: fixed min-max from the pinned grid, not from observed data

features.rationale: Fixed rather than data-derived scaling, so the feature of a candidate never depends on which points happen to have been revealed.

missing_policy.must_report: the number of times each of the five ids was selected, per arm and per seed

feasibility_model.type: L2-regularised logistic regression fitted by iteratively reweighted least squares (Newton), numpy only
feasibility_model.class_weight: balanced: each observation weighted n_total / (2 * n_its_class)
feasibility_model.refit: once per optimised batch, not once per selection

numerics.solver: Newton steps with the L2 term added to the Hessian; no random component

feasibility_model.no_label_guarantee: the model reads only attempt statuses and candidate features; it never receives m1, m2, m3 or any hidden label

surrogate.kernel_formula: k(x,x') = sigma_f2 * (1 + s + s*s/3) * exp(-s), s = sqrt(5)*||x-x'||/lengthscale
surrogate.hyperparameter_fit: exhaustive grid search maximising the exact log marginal likelihood; no gradient optimiser, so no platform-dependent line search
surrogate.grid_tie_break: lowest flat index in the order (lengthscale, sigma_f2, sigma_n2)
surrogate.target_standardisation: mean and standard deviation of the observed targets only; never the full label set. A zero standard deviation is replaced by 1.0.

acquisition.objective_normalisation: each minimize-form objective is min-max scaled using observed points only; a zero range is replaced by 1.0

expected_improvement.incumbent: minimum observed scalarised value in the current round's weighting
expected_improvement.normal_cdf_pdf: closed form via math.erf; no scipy

acquisition.selection: argmin over unseen candidates of the negative expected improvement
acquisition.tie_break: largest expected improvement first, then smallest id; whether a tie occurred is recorded in the trace

constants.temperature_source: OEDB Methods: production runs were carried out under NVT conditions at 298 K

mechanism.raw_estimate: sigma_NE_raw(x) = 1e4 * (F^2 / (R*T)) * b(x) * (D_Li_hat(x) + D_anion_hat(x)) in mS/cm, with b the molality in mol/kg from the candidate key taken as mol/L at 1 kg/L (x1000 to mol/m3) and the S/m result converted to mS/cm (x10)

diffusivity_inputs.D_Li_hat: posterior mean of a GP fitted on observed -log10(D_Li), inverted back to linear units
diffusivity_inputs.D_anion_hat: D_Li_hat multiplied by the running median of the observed D_anion / D_Li ratio; the ratio prior before any observation is 1.0

haven_like_correction.definition: sigma_NE_raw / sigma_observed, evaluated only on already-revealed points with status ok
haven_like_correction.shrinkage: log10(h) is shrunk toward the prior log10(h0)=0 with weight n/(n+n0)
haven_like_correction.causality: The value used in round t is computed from rounds 1..t-1 only. The implementation snapshots the correction before the oracle is called, and a test recomputes it independently from the prefix of the observation log.

memory.rule: noise_inflation = clip(1 + mean(|residual| over the last k rounds) / residual_scale, 1.0, cap)

evaluator_only.access_note: This block is label-derived. Only OEDBEvaluator may read it. A test asserts that no agent module imports it.
evaluator_only.reference_point_rule: per-coordinate maximum over the truth set in minimize form, extended by 5% of that coordinate's range, rounded to 1e-10
evaluator_only.top1pct_rule: ceil(0.01 * 1867) points with the smallest equal-weight mean of the min-max normalised minimize-form objectives, ties broken by smallest id
evaluator_only.derived_constants_sha256_payload: sha256 of json.dumps({truth_set_size, reference_point, hv_true, pareto_ids, top1pct_k, top1pct_ids}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) encoded utf-8

source_provenance.citation: [@nakamura2026oedb] Nakamura et al., npj Comput. Mater. (2026)

access_method.server_name: MCP for Open Electrolyte Database for Batteries (OEDB)
access_method.note: OEDB is not a git repository. 'repository' carries the MCP endpoint and 'commit' the published data version.
